summary: Keep iOS sidebar cached projections valid during same-revision resolution changes

compatibility.detail: Only successful projections are cached. Every lookup checks all live folders for resolved parents and compares them to the cached tree, without scanning membership rows. Missing resolution clears the cache; changed parent values rebuild even at the same revision. The host model revision still covers raw folder/register changes outside the arrangement revision.

manual.detail: No manual action required; native activation and daemon prerequisite gates remain unchanged.
